featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!
featured.rule:

* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Daugavpils.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.

* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

today.name: CONVOY DECEPTICONS  ROBO DE CAMIONES A LOS AUTOBOTS
today.description:
TEMATICA DE TRANSPORTE DE CAMIONES 


El cielo sobre las carreteras del Pacífico Noroeste amenazaba tormenta cuando el convoy clandestino cruzó la frontera estatal de Montana. Tres imponentes camiones con especificaciones de los Autobots avanzaban en perfecta formación, pero sus sistemas de navegación habituales habían sido completamente hackeados. En las pantallas de sus cabinas parpadeaba un frío emblema morado.
	Los Decepticons habían ejecutado una emboscada perfecta en los talleres mecánicos de Sandpoint, Montana, apoderándose de valiosa tecnología de transporte enemiga. Ahora, la misión consistía en llevar el botín hasta su base secreta de operaciones en Sidney, Montana, antes de que la resistencia local o las patrullas fronterizas detectaran la anomalía.
A la vanguardia del grupo, guiando la ruta a través de los desolados paisajes montañosos de la Interestatal 90 y las rutas secundarias hacia el este, un imponente camión escolta lideraba la marcha. A través de la frecuencia encriptada de Truckers MP, el comandante a cargo emitió una orden directa a las unidades de soporte:
—Mantengan la formación en US Simulation y desactiven los rastreadores GPS de las cargas. Nos dirigimos directo a los sectores del este. Si algún rezagado interfiere en el camino a Sidney, aplástenlo.
Los motores diésel rugieron al unísono, devorando kilómetros de asfalto en la penumbra. Con los mapas de navegación fijados firmemente en las coordenadas finales de Sidney, el convoy avanzaba implacable. Cada cambio de marcha acercaba a los Decepticons a consolidar su dominio logístico en el sector, dejando atrás a unos Autobots totalmente desprovistos de sus mejores transportes.

today.description:
## EXPORT OF CZECH LITERATURE TO THE BOOK FAIR!
- Export České literatury na Frakfurtský knižní veletrh!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/Y7M4QMA.jpeg)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited to the Office Papers.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, if you need please use translator, we will also use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **20:00**  - Meetup at parking slots in Brno.
*  **20:30** -  Departure from the Brno to the Germany border.
*  **20:40** -  Passage around the city of Prague.
*  **21:00** -  Passage around the city of Dresden.
*  **21:15** -  Passage around the city of Kassel.
*  **21:25** -  Convoy arrival to the Frankfurt.
*  **21:30** -  Final group photo and end of the event.

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/agKlA15.png)

**1. Brno, LKW // Trameri - Frankfurt, Transinet.**

To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.

**Konvoi-Informationen**

* TMP-Server: Simulator 2 / Event-Server
* Treffen: 20:00 Uhr
* Abfahrt: 21:00 Uhr
* Treffpunkt: Dortmund
* Zielort: Innsbruck (EuroGoodies)
* Streckenlänge: ca. 982 km
* Pausen: keine
* Anhänger: Kühlauflieger mit max. 7 t Fracht (kein HCT)
* Kommunikation: Ingame


**Regeln für den Konvoi**

- Der LKW muss vor Beginn vollständig repariert und vollgetankt sein.
- Alle Teilnehmer müssen rechtzeitig vor Abfahrt am Treffpunkt erscheinen.
- Den Anweisungen der **TIA Convoy Escort** ist jederzeit Folge zu leisten.
- Absichtliche Unfälle oder Rammaktionen sind strengstens verboten.
- Es ist stets ein ausreichender Sicherheitsabstand einzuhalten (100–150 m).
- Überholen ist nur erlaubt, wenn es ausdrücklich freigegeben wird.
- Die Kolonne ist geschlossen zu halten. Falls notwendig, darf kurzzeitig schneller gefahren werden, um wieder aufzuschließen.
- Jeder Fahrer bleibt auf seiner zugewiesenen Position in der Kolonne.



Bei Fragen oder anderen Anliegen, sind wir für die Kontaktaufnahme auf unserem Discord-Server erreichbar!

upcoming.description:
# 🚛 🎗️ **TCCR Pink Convoy: A Journey for Her**  



## 🎗️ ABOUT THE EVENT  

This is not just a convoy.  

This October, TCCR invites you to be part of something meaningful —  
**“Pink Convoy: A Journey for Her”**  

A charity event dedicated to the fight against breast cancer,  
and a personal tribute that makes this convoy truly special.
  
This event is held **in honor of a mother** —  
a symbol of strength, love, and resilience.  

Through her story, we stand with every woman  
who has faced, is facing, or will face this battle.
  
💖 Together, we drive with purpose.  

---

## 💰 CHARITY & DONATIONS  

We are raising funds to support the fight against breast cancer.  

🎗️ **How to support:**  
  
* Donate through our official campaign link  https://www.goodcrowd.org/c/baf0jTCR   
* Share the event  
* Join the convoy and be part of the message  

All contributions help bring awareness and support to this cause.  

---

## 🎀 DONATION LEVELS  

💖 **$5 — In Memory**  
🌸 **$10 — Supporter**  
🎗️ **$25 — Pink Warrior**  
👑 **$50 — Legacy**  

Every contribution matters. Every name becomes part of this journey.  


## 🤝 PARTNERS & VTCs  

We welcome all VTCs and communities to be part of this cause.  

If your VTC would like to participate or collaborate,  
feel free to contact us.  

💖 Let’s make this convoy a united effort.  

---

---

## 📌 EVENT INFORMATION  

**📅 Date:** Sunday , October 18, 2026  
**🕒 Meetup Time:** 18:30 UTC  
**🚚 Departure Time:** 19:30 UTC 

**📍 Start Location:** Calais  (Slots)

## 📸 MEDIA & COVERAGE  

* Official screenshots will be taken  
* Recap will be published after the event  
* Streaming is highly encouraged  


This convoy is more than a route.  

It is a tribute.  
A memory.  
A message of hope.  

🎗️ Join us. Drive with us.  
Drive for her.
